biography:
Leading Power Solutions & Resources in the Americas for Equinix, my mission is to innovate and secure reliable energy for our data centers. My work involves analyzing power grids and fostering strategic partnerships to support Equinix's expansion with a focus on sustainability and efficiency. With expertise in power generation and smart grids, I contribute to the company's leadership in energy transition.

My recent role in Strategic Partnerships at the National Renewable Energy Laboratory honed my competencies in developing integrated energy systems for decarbonization, encompassing hydrogen, e-Fuels, and renewable sources like wind, geothermal, and solar. My efforts in building and data center energy efficiency have positioned our team at the forefront of advancing the industry's environmental goals.
